dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I certainly would. What is on your mind today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't remember what I wanted to talk about...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: That is well. We can discuss any matter you please. Death, freedom, meaning, and solitude... or what we shall have to eat later.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: And yet — perhaps I understand this state of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: When people deliberately seek conversation with others, it's... it is easy for their efforts to be in vain.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: If we wish to speak, we should not hesitate. Whatever thoughts linger in your heart, say them, and do so decisively.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: No matter how trivial these thoughts may seem, what matters is that they are said and heard.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: For instance, if you see an insect on your way out today, or if you plan to go fishing later.

choices.text: I thought of something. Why do you keep your hair long, Flins?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: You mean, why do I not cut it short and neat, like my colleagues? Why this look, of all choices?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: ...I see, I did not expect you to take an interest in my appearance. Hmm, yes, knowing this has helped me understand you better.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Have you heard the saying? "One's appearance is a reflection of their innermost thoughts and experiences."

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: There was a time when my long, smooth hair was a symbol of my status. It was a habit for me, back then...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I suppose this will suffice as an answer to your question.

choices.text: I thought of something. Do you know anything about Snezhnograd, Flins?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I recall that you intend to visit Snezhnograd in the future. It is indeed necessary to gather relevant information before your departure.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: ...Regrettably, my memories of it are hazy, but what remains tells me that it was a beautiful place.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: The brilliant night sky, the never-ending blizzard... It seems that nowadays, it's become rather industrialized.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Some fae still live there. Perhaps they have gotten used to the biting cold, and are no longer able to survive in a warm place.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Hmm... I wonder what Snezhnograd looks like now...
